env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^ok \{"tag":"user-rt"\}$'

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go

exec grep -rhnE '_logos_[A-Za-z0-9_]+ "github\.com/gosuda/loGos/[^"]*"' out --include=*.go
cp stdout $WORK/collide-support-imports.txt
! exec grep -vE '_logos_(rt|json) "github\.com/gosuda/loGos/rt(/json)?"' $WORK/collide-support-imports.txt
exec grep -rhnE '_logos_json "github\.com/gosuda/loGos/rt/json"' out --include=*.go

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
stdout '^ok \{"tag":"user-rt"\}$'
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/collide

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

type Pay struct {
	Tag string `json:"tag"`
}

func load(s string) (string, error) {
	p := Pay{Tag: s}
	buf := p.MarshalJSON()?
	fmt.Println("loaded", string(buf))
	return string(buf), nil
}

func main() {
	out, err := load("user-rt")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error:", err)
		return
	}
	if !json.Valid([]byte(out)) {
		fmt.Println("invalid")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", out)
}
